# AFUVAI Society

> AFUVAI Society is a high-end, by-appointment luxury floral design studio in Las Vegas, Nevada. Founded by designer Ami Nelson, AFUVAI Society designs bespoke weddings and events, everyday and sympathy arrangements, hands-on floral-making classes, and signature bouquets delivered across the valley. The brand's signature is a Samoan motif. AFUVAI Society does not operate a walk-in retail store; bespoke work is by appointment.

## Service Area
Las Vegas, Summerlin, Henderson, North Las Vegas, and venues across The Las Vegas Strip.

## Shop by Occasion & Starting Prices
- Weddings — bespoke, from $3,500 (by consultation)
- Events & Corporate — from $1,500 (by consultation)
- Everyday arrangements & bouquets — from $95 (order online, delivered)
- The Flower Purse — $145 (luxury acrylic bouquet with gold chain, gift or party keepsake)
- Sympathy tributes — from $175 (order online, delivered)
- Bulk Flowers — individual bunches from $20; curated DIY kits from $95 (order online, Las Vegas delivery)
- Flower Purse Party — private event from $125/person, 10-person minimum (bachelorettes, bridal showers, birthdays)
- Floral-Making Classes & private floral events — seats from $125
- Floral Subscriptions — coming soon

## What Makes AFUVAI Society Distinct
Built on a luxury hospitality background and a Samoan-motif heritage signature, AFUVAI Society pairs fully bespoke wedding and event design with an online occasion shop (everyday + sympathy), hands-on floral classes, and a by-appointment consultation process.
